name: Player Ranks
description: Shows each connected player's external rating in Live Status. qlstats and Slipgate are installation-wide switches (same for every instance); Thunderdome elo-service and the game server's own status data are configured per instance. Each enabled source gets its own column. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer.

global.label: Slipgate: API key / token
global.description: Optional -- with a key, one bulk request covers the whole roster; without one, one public request per player.

global.label: Thunderdome elo-service API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. This source returns nothing without a key, on any instance.

instance.label: internal: has this instance's Ranks tab ever been saved
Thunderdome elo-service: API key / token override
instance.description: Required -- nothing is returned without it. Blank falls back to the installation-wide default set on the Addons page.

instance.label: Thunderdome elo-service: game type / pool
instance.description: Leave blank to use the server's live game type. There is no fixed list of pools -- set this to the exact pool name the service was configured with.

instance.label: From the game server's own status data: show column

instance_ranks.description: qlstats and Slipgate are switched on for the whole installation from Settings -> Addons -> Player Ranks, not here. This tab only covers what genuinely varies per instance: Thunderdome elo-service (a different service/pool per host is common) and the server's own status data. If server.cfg already carries qlx_rankedServiceUrl, the first load here suggests matching values -- nothing is written until you hit Save.

fields.label: Thunderdome elo-service: API key / token override
fields.description: Required -- nothing is returned without it. Blank uses the installation-wide default from Settings.

fields.label: Thunderdome elo-service: game type / pool
fields.description: Blank = use the server's live game type. Set this to the exact pool name it was configured with.

fields.label: From the game server's own status data: show column

global_sources.description: qlstats and Slipgate apply to every instance at once -- one switch, not one per server. Thunderdome elo-service and the server's own status data are still configured per instance, on that instance's own Ranks tab.
